The '''Atterol system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Atravis sector/Legends|Atravis sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
It was in this system that an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] convoy, under escort of the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] ''[[Tegret]]'', was [[Battle of Atterol|attacked]] by a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] force consisting of [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]], [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] and 3 [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport]]s.<ref name="XWvTF" />

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
While the occurrence of the space battle and participants depicted in [[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter|''X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter'']] is C-[[canon]], the outcome depends on the actions of the player and is therefore indeterminate. For lack of other canonical information, it should be assumed that no lasting effect (such as the destruction of the station or a starship) resulted from the battle.
